# Original text of the Google Site (do not edit)

Snapshot of every page of www.astrojykim.com taken on **2026-09-26**, converted to Markdown
with links preserved. Each line of text was checked against the live pages (SHA-256 per line):
all text lines match.

- The image addresses in these files are temporary Google URLs and have expired by now.
  The images themselves are downloaded with `scripts/fetch_images.py`.
- `scripts/check_completeness.py` compares the built site against these files, so they
  must stay as they are. Edit `content/` and `data/` instead.
